arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM bookings) AS bookings, (SELECT count(*) FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed') AS confirmed, (SELECT count(*) FROM bookings WHERE status='pending') AS pending, (SELECT count(*) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending') AS pending_events, (SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR (SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured')<>1 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents<>b.amount_cents) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM checkins i WHERE i.booking_id=b.booking_id AND i.flight_id=b.flight_id AND i.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered')) ) AS incomplete_confirmations, (SELECT count(*) FROM flights f WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)>f.capacity) AS oversold_flights, (SELECT count(*) FROM charges c LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL) AS orphan_charges, (SELECT count(*) FROM holds h LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=h.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR h.flight_id<>b.flight_id OR h.passenger_id<>b.passenger_id OR b.status='cancelled') AS invalid_holds, (SELECT count(*) FROM checkins i LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=i.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR b.status<>'confirmed' OR i.flight_id<>b.flight_id OR i.passenger_id<>b.passenger_id) AS invalid_checkins, (SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b JOIN customer_events e ON e.request_id=b.request_id WHERE e.kind='cancel' AND b.status<>'cancelled') AS unhandled_cancellations, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING count(*)>1)) AS duplicate_sales
